summary: Prepare untested bonded LiDAR-to-haptics runtime and deployment helpers
details: Build on the existing Mac calibration branch. Add a camera-independent saved-bond Pi receiver with clock diagnostics, original-age gates, bounded obstacle-side haptics and automatic connection recovery; optional camera/context path shares the same Pi session. Add validated tuning, service/config installer and versioned Windows transfer. Phone transient connection/session loss recovers automatically with a fresh epoch. No wire/model/registry or live service changes.
validation: Automated and physical tests intentionally not added or run at Michael's request; syntax/parser and git diff inspection only. Xcode/phone/Pi/server operation remains unverified for these changes. Real GPIO still requires an explicit supported clock-drift bound; none is fabricated or copied from old conditional measurement evidence. Final manual procedure and limits are documented.
